claims.quote: a two-gene signature (GRIA2 and RYR3) associated with survival was selected in the GSE16011 dataset.
The GRIA2-RYR3 signature divided patients into two risk groups with significantly different survival
the survival predictive potency of the signature was independent from clinicopathological prognostic features in multivariable Cox analysis.
